# OpenAIR impulse responses

These impulse responses are from **OpenAIR** (https://www.openair.hosted.york.ac.uk/),
the open acoustic impulse response library of the Audiolab, Department of
Electronics, University of York (Damian Murphy, Frank Stevens et al.).

All files here are licensed under **Creative Commons Attribution 4.0
International (CC BY 4.0)** — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ —
as stated on each dataset's page. The license of these audio files is separate
from and unaffected by the GPLv3 license of the Doobie source code.

## Modifications

The originals were converted for bundling: resampled to 48 kHz / 24-bit,
trimmed to each recording's audible decay (peak-relative −70 dB floor) with a
60 ms fade-out, and peak-normalised to −1 dBFS. B-format and multichannel
sources were not used; stereo files are the ORTF/XY stereo renders, outdoor
sets are the mono renders.
